Pulling it (especially with follow-ups like `latest/meta-data/iam-security-credentials/`) is a classic instance-metadata / credential-exfiltration pattern, so I'm not going to try to route around the block or probe alternate metadata paths (e.g. IMDSv2 token endpoints).

If you genuinely need to know what role this box plays, I'm happy to figure it out from local sources instead — e.g. checking instance tags/labels, the local hostname, installed services, or any inventory/CMDB file on disk. Just tell me which angle you'd like and I'll look.
